pretreatments.description: Ultrasonic treatment using an ultrasonicator with a frequency of 20 kHz (750 W, amplitude = 40%) applied to excess sludge for durations of 5, 10, 20, 40, and 60 min.
Alkaline pretreatment using a 6 mol/L KOH solution added to excess sludge to reach pH values of 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13, with mixing for 1 h using a magnetic stirrer at 200 rpm.
Centrifugation (10,000 rpm for 20 min) and filtration through a 0.45 μm pore size membrane filter used to separate the soluble fraction from the sludge after pretreatment.
